title: Add admin-only purge to delete all old system data

requirements.text: Add an admin-only backend function to purge old/legacy data by deleting all DailyServiceReport records and deleting all user profiles except the calling admin user (to avoid locking the system), and ensure authorization roles are revoked for any deleted users.
acceptanceCriteria: Calling the purge function as a non-admin traps with an authorization error.
Calling the purge function as an admin deletes all entries from the reports map.
Calling the purge function as an admin deletes all userProfiles entries for principals other than the caller.
After purge, listReports returns an empty array for admin and non-admin callers (non-admin may still be denied if they no longer have a profile).
After purge, listUsers returns an array containing only the caller's (Principal, UserProfile) entry.
Deleted users can no longer pass permission checks after purge (their AccessControl role is revoked/removed).

requirements.text: Expose the purge operation in the frontend admin area by adding a destructive "Delete all old data" action on the Admin Users page with an explicit confirmation dialog, and wire it to a new React Query mutation that calls the backend purge function and invalidates relevant cached queries (users, reports, currentUserProfile).
acceptanceCriteria: The Admin Users page shows a destructive action labeled "Delete all old data" that is only reachable/usable by admins (consistent with existing admin gating).
Clicking the action opens a confirmation dialog that clearly states all reports and all users except the current admin will be deleted, and that the action cannot be undone.
Confirming successfully triggers the backend purge call and shows an in-progress state while the mutation is pending.
On success, the UI refreshes such that the users list shows only the current admin and report history shows no reports.
On error, the UI displays a readable error message (English) without crashing.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Adding an audit log of purge actions.
Supporting selective purges (e.g., by date range) unless explicitly requested later.
